maddeler.e:
تشاعرت (form VI)
# تَشَاعَرْتُ (tašāʕartu) /ta.ʃaː.ʕar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# تَشَاعَرْتَ (tašāʕarta) /ta.ʃaː.ʕar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# تَشَاعَرْتِ (tašāʕarti) /ta.ʃaː.ʕar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# تَشَاعَرَتْ (tašāʕarat) /ta.ʃaː.ʕa.rat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
